description: The fline.json for this project's current plan. Save it at the root of the archive you upload and the next deploy builds from it directly, with no analysis: the same plan every time. A short content check and the step that writes the build files still run. Edit it when the project changes, and check the edit with check_config. env_names is not names-only: an entry may be an object with a value, which is how a prebuilt image is configured — see check_config. A public service's health_path is the path fline checks while the app is online, such as /healthz. Keep it when you edit the file: with fline.json committed nothing finds it again, and an empty one means fline checks the front page.
name: get_config
title: Get fline.json
